column3: Requests that started at or before the journal loss horizon (+16 ms slack) are left out and counted, with BootUI's LEFT_OUT_BEFORE_LOSS wording, in the check reason and the report limitations (RuntimeInsightsService.visibleEntries, leftOutBeforeLoss, v2.3.0; EvidenceRing.lost). Not ported: the AI calls linked only by a trace and the ERROR logs without a request id that BootUI also counts (aiCallsLeftOut, errorLogsLeftOut), executions other than http, and the clear-time evictedRequestTraces; each needs its own producer fact.
